desc:
CHEWY GRANOLA BARS: Chewy granola and crunchy almonds dipped in an indulgent almond butter coating for a sweet, creamy treat; A must-have for an on-the-go snack or in a lunch box

SWEET AND SALTY: Nature Valley Sweet and Salty Nut Bars provides a perfect balance of savory nuts and sweet granola

PERFECTLY PORTABLE: Easy bars for snack time or an on-the-go invigorating treat; Perfect for the pantry, lunch box, and hiking trail

TASTY SNACK: No artificial flavors, artificial colors, or high fructose corn syrup

CONTAINS: One 7.2 oz box of Nature Valley Almond Sweet and Salty Nut Granola Bars; 6 bars
features:
Features

Crunchy Almonds & Chewy Granola

A delicious combination of roasted almonds, chewy granola, and a sweet almond butter coating.

Made with Whole Grain Oats

Delivers 12–14g of whole grains per serving, making it a more nutritious snacking option.

No Artificial Flavors or Colors

Free from artificial flavors, colors, and high-fructose corn syrup.

Individually Wrapped Bars

Comes in easy-to-carry single packs—perfect for on-the-go snacking or lunchbox additions.

Sweet & Salty Blend

The flavor profile balances nutty richness with just the right amount of sweetness.

Benefits

Satisfies Hunger Between Meals

A smart choice for mid-morning or afternoon energy dips, keeping you fueled without feeling heavy.

Family & Kid Approved

A snack both adults and kids enjoy, making it a staple for school, office, or travel.

Wholesome Snacking Made Simple

Offers real ingredients without the worry of unwanted additives.

Guilt-Free Treat

Satisfies your sweet tooth while still fitting into a balanced eating plan.

Energy You Can Trust

Great for busy days, workouts, or outdoor activities—reliable energy without the crash.
ingredients: Almonds, Corn Syrup, Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Rice Flour, Palm Kernel Oil, Vegetable Glycerin, Honey Roasted Almond Butter (almonds, honey, maltodextrin, palm oil, mixed tocopherols), Fructose, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Whey, Soy Lecithin, Salt, Corn Starch, Barley Malt Extract, Baking Soda, Natural Flavor, Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Retain Freshness.
